description:
Search the drug boards by free text and by field.

`query` also matches the other indications a molecule is pursuing, from the indications matrix
(MASH, CKD, sleep apnea, heart failure, CV outcomes, type 2 diabetes, and their trial names),
so "MASH" finds every cardiometabolic drug with a MASH programme and its status. `sponsor`
also matches a partner the matrix names (survodutide is licensed from Zealand Pharma to
Boehringer Ingelheim). Each result carries its `indications` row, or null for a drug the
matrix does not cover (cancer and immunology drugs, and MASH-only drugs, are not in it).
name: search_drugs
title: Search drugs
